message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && python3 -c "
import struct
with open('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

header_len = 92
cbytes = 36733
coffsets_pos = header_len + cbytes
print(f'Coffsets at: {coffsets_pos}')
print(f'Coffsets bytes (first 64): {data[coffsets_pos:coffsets_pos+64].hex()}')
print(f'File size: {len(data)}')
print(f'Remaining after coffsets: {len(data) - coffsets_pos}')

# Parse the coffsets chunk header
# BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH = 32
# The chunk header contains: version, versionlz, flags, typesize, nbytes, blocksize, cbytes
# Let's look at the first 32 bytes
chunk = data[coffsets_pos:coffsets_pos+32]
print(f'Chunk header: {chunk.hex()}')
print(f'Version: {chunk[0]}')
print(f'VersionLZ: {chunk[1]}')
print(f'Flags: {hex(chunk[2])}')
print(f'Typesize: {chunk[3]}')
print(f'Nbytes: {struct.unpack(\">i\", chunk[4:8])[0]}')
print(f'Blocksize: {struct.unpack(\">i\", chunk[8:12])[0]}')
print(f'Cbytes: {struct.unpack(\">i\", chunk[12:16])[0]}')
"
